releases.title: More control in fullscreen.
features: Use the arrow keys in fullscreen: left and right seek, and up and down change the volume. Hold Shift for bigger steps.
Hover over the cover art in fullscreen to like the song without leaving the view.
fixes: The Jump to current button now appears after you scroll in both lyrics styles, and clicking it returns to the playing line right away.
Spicy lyrics now stay where you scroll instead of jumping back to the current line after a few seconds.

releases.title: New player bar fixes.
fixes: The dot on the progress line now takes the artwork's colour and glides smoothly with the line.
The 'Always show the volume slider' switch is greyed out on the new player bar, which has its own volume slider.

releases.title: Ready for YouTube Music's new player bar.
fixes: Lyrics load again now that YouTube Music has replaced its player bar.
Play, pause, skip, seek, volume, artwork and the fullscreen title all work with the new bar, and the old bar still works exactly as before.
Like and dislike in fullscreen now rate the song instead of only changing the icon.
Custom player-bar icons cover the playback and menu buttons on the new bar.
The Dynamic theme's frosted bar and artwork accent colour follow the new bar, including a progress line that takes the thumbnail's colour.
The Now Playing panel's page shift and the fullscreen chrome follow the new bar too.
The 'Song info left, controls centred' switch is greyed out when the new bar already lays itself out that way.
Artwork tinting now colours the whole progress line, so the colour no longer turns pink as the song plays.
Smooth progress line now works on the new bar, so the line glides instead of jumping once a second.

releases.title: Aurora Lyrics, from the start.
features: Word-level synced lyrics in the YouTube Music Lyrics tab, with the active word lit and the lines around it stepping back.
A fullscreen view over the artwork, with a per-track offset and romanization for Japanese and Korean tracks.
Lyrics from Spicy Lyrics and LRCLIB, with a manual search in the panel when the automatic lookup misses.
Optional add-ons: the Aurora Bloom backdrop with artwork tinting, Aurora Flow, Next Up, song notes, a sleep timer and picture-in-picture lyrics, plus snippets.
No account, no analytics, no Aurora server. The track's title, artist, album and duration are the only things sent anywhere.
